# Agents that call each other in a circle stop with a clear message.
# (from link_cycle)

# a cycle is only found when the agents run, so `check` is happy
exec metagente check cycle_a.ag
stdout 'No problems found'

! exec metagente run cycle_a.ag go
stderr 'CycleA asked CycleB, and CycleB asked CycleA again \(CycleA -> CycleB -> CycleA\)'
stderr 'make one of them answer without calling the other'

! exec metagente run loop.ag go
stderr 'Loop -> Loop'

# a missing target says where it looked
! exec metagente check boss_ghost.ag
stderr 'Problem on line 3 of boss_ghost\.ag'
stderr 'I could not find an agent called Ghost'
stderr 'I looked:'
stderr 'link Ghost from "path/to/file\.ag"'

# an error inside the linked agent keeps its own file and line
! exec metagente run outer.ag go
stderr 'Problem on line 6 of outer\.ag: Inner could not answer `go`'
stderr 'Problem on line 6 of inner\.ag'
stderr 'the file `missing\.txt` does not exist'

-- cycle_a.ag --
agent CycleA
  goal "Call CycleB, which calls back"
  link CycleB from "cycle_b.ag"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply CycleB.go
-- cycle_b.ag --
agent CycleB
  goal "Call CycleA, which called me"
  link CycleA from "cycle_a.ag"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply CycleA.go
-- loop.ag --
agent Loop
  goal "l"
  link Loop
  accepts go
  on go
    reply Loop.go
-- boss_ghost.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Ghost
  accepts go
  on go
    reply Ghost.hi
-- outer.ag --
agent Outer
  goal "o"
  link Inner
  accepts go
  on go
    reply Inner.go
-- inner.ag --
agent Inner
  goal "i"
  tool file
  accepts go
  on go
    reply file.read path: "missing.txt"
